dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned rows and missingness classes feed mechanism-specific imputation.
Completed school attributes feed the jobs and Goodness construction.
Jobs added feed unemployment and GDP change.
Constructed Goodness feeds pooled and local Bayesian curves.
Local curve structure is recomputed under yearly national forecasts.
Year-indexed curves feed greedy marginal allocation.
The unconstrained allocation and its concentration anomaly feed the capped recommendation.
